text:
alex: Quick sketch: introduce a lightweight 'config-probe' API to run tiny live checks before rollouts.

maria: what counts as tiny?

alex: default 0.2% sample for 30s, configurable 0.1-0.5%. returns a probe_id and a short safety summary.

jordan: how do we avoid polluting billing/quotas?

samir: tag requests at ingress with X-Preview=true and make downstream services ignore those for quota and cost buckets. router handles sampling.

liz: cache interactions are tricky. can we set X-Preview-Ttl=0 to bypass short caches?

alex: yes, and the probe should run in shadow mode so writes are optional. propose POST /config/probe {config_id, pct, duration, dedupe_key, metrics}. GET /config/probe/{id}/summary.

maria: need audit fields and a retention policy for summaries (90d) + raw traces (7d).

jordan: I'll add metric tagging; retention TTLs accepted.

samir: add an auto-fail rule: if safety_score < 0.9, mark probe FAIL and notify channel. also cap concurrent probes per org.

alex: UX: modal with green/yellow/red, top diffs, "start gradual rollout" CTA. Idempotency with dedupe_key.
